purpose: Keep the model-host SSH private key permanently root-only on the existing REG.RU production host instead of transporting it through GitHub Actions, and prevent finalization from running when activation did not create release state.
requiredBehavior: store the dedicated model-host private key only at /etc/pc-release-authority/model_id on production
keep the key root-owned, mode 0600 and outside the runner workspace
send only non-secret model user and port metadata through runner input
never reference or materialize a private model SSH key in GitHub Actions
run finalization only after activation successfully created release state
preserve activation trap rollback for failures after mutation begins
retain the non-root runner and restricted controller-only sudo authority
forbiddenCapabilities: private SSH key transport through GitHub Actions or repository secrets
